amends: evaluation and a second Colab stage (exploratory, post hoc); requested by the coordinator after PR #13
author: Claude Opus 5.5 (designated executor)
status: Exploratory. Committed before any remedy number, night-calibration manifest use or Colab allocation of this stage; commit time is authoritative (no written_utc stamp, see review F4).
question: How much of the night threshold-removed loss can a threshold remedy recover, and at what FPPI cost? The no-matched-candidate part (IoU 0.5, score 1e-4) is unrecoverable by any threshold.

calibration_data.final: BDD legacy TRAIN images with timeofday=night (any weather; matches the val night stratum), never used in training (training was clear-day only). The first 2000 by sha256('bdd-night-calibration-v1:'+image_stem); frozen manifest hash recorded before Colab inference.
calibration_data.cpu_proxy: Split-half of BDD val night by sha256('bdd-valnight-half-v1:'+image_stem) parity: calibrate on one half, test on the other, both directions reported separately. Labelled as a proxy: same domain and split as the test half, so it is optimistic relative to the final train-night calibration.

rules.equal_recall: night threshold = highest calibration score with night calibration recall >= the source recall target (B: 0.80; matched-FPPI arms: the clear-day selection recall at t*(L)). Undefined if infeasible.
rules.equal_fppi: night threshold = lowest calibration score with night calibration FPPI <= the clear-day budget (B: clear-day selection FPPI at t*(0.80); matched arms: L).

b_score_calibration.model: Platt scaling p = sigmoid(a * logit(s) + b), maximum likelihood on candidates labelled TP=1/FP=0 (ignored excluded) at score >= 1e-4. Temperature scaling is the b=0 special case.
b_score_calibration.global: fitted on the clear-day selection split only. With a > 0 it is strictly monotone, so threshold reselection on the selection split selects identical detections: recovery is exactly zero by construction (reported as a check, not a result).
b_score_calibration.per_condition: night map fitted on the night calibration data; night threshold = raw score s_n with p_night(s_n) = p_clear(t*) (equal calibrated confidence at the operating boundary), where p_clear is fitted on the selection split.
b_score_calibration.fixed_probability_consumer: also reported: thresholding the global map at p_clear(t*) at night, which equals the transferred raw threshold (no recovery).

operating_points: A, B, C (and B2 when available) at matched clear-day FPPI L in {0.5, 1, 2, 4.5}
metrics_per_remedy: night test recall and FPPI; delta vs the transferred threshold; recovered fraction = delta recall / threshold part (held_out_loss_decomposition vs val clear day) and / night removable misses (night ceiling - transferred night recall); the no-matched-candidate part is reported alongside as the unrecoverable remainder. 95% image bootstrap, 1000 replicates: selection, calibration and test images resampled independently, with thresholds and Platt maps refitted in every replicate.

colab_stage_2.session: one L4 session, Claude-owned, verified teardown; datasets reach Colab only by direct download with SHA-256 checks (no dataset upload from this PC); model weights and the scripts/manifests packet are uploaded
colab_stage_2.B2: 1280 px, seed 1, otherwise identical to B (amendment 1), 100 epochs, last.pt evaluated with B's preregistered protocol (selection t* at 0.80, val strata)
colab_stage_2.night_calibration_inference: A/C at 640, B/B2 at 1280 on the 2000-image BDD train-night manifest; same candidate policy (floor 1e-4, cap 3000, class-aware NMS 0.7)
colab_stage_2.acdc: if budget allows: direct download from the ACDC package API (unauthenticated token endpoint; SHA-256 per docs/datasets/acdc_archive_manifest.json), inference for A/B/C/B2 on the labelled adverse images (train 1600 + val 406) and annotated references (800 + 203); descriptive external panel only, BDD source thresholds unchanged, ACDC 'person' = pedestrian, iscrowd as ignore regions
colab_stage_2.not_in_scope: NightOwls (owned by GPT Sol, CPU only)
